title: DOW-UAP-D081, Narrative Statement 3, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This is a Department of War memorandum for record containing a firsthand narrative from a federal law enforcement agent regarding UAP and an anomalous vehicle encounter.

encounters.summary: Federal law enforcement agents observed a vehicle on the ground that appeared to respond to their approach by maintaining distance before floating off the road across rough terrain without leaving tire tracks.
encounters.quote: the vehicle then seemingly floated off the road to the south, across rough terrain.
